seasons.title: Odd Jobs and Hidden Badges
seasons.arc_summary: The party takes mercenary courier work, uncovers an Oogathal conspiracy posing as Blackline cops, becomes Magical Crimes Convox consultants, and descends into the sewers to discover Grayson's necromantic manor beneath the city.

seasons.title: Through the Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A catastrophic TPK at the Crowded Flea sends three party members through death and back via the Black and White entity Aut; the reformed party hunts down Hlarf and Tywelwyn, uncovering a six-god conspiracy to crack the firmament via radar dishes.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: The cosmic Narrative of Aut and Renge is revealed when Anaïs is rescued; the party attends a mysterious pilgrimage gathering at Ragged Roost, competes in a gladiatorial trial and keystone scavenger hunt, and claims their first lodestone through art theft, diplomacy, and blood.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: Argyle returns from the dead as only half a man; after six months of downtime the party investigates Teller's Run's sewers, discovers a hairline fracture in reality with an imprisoned deity behind it, and bombs the research compound exploiting it.

seasons.title: The Voidward Road
seasons.arc_summary: The party embarks aboard the colossal Strider on a voidward pilgrimage, births their heart Eerie, navigates cutthroat faction politics among nineteen organizations, survives the deadly weekly tithe, and explores the mutated depths of the Undercroft.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Quorum and the Voice of Many
seasons.arc_summary: A Scale strike team ventures to a shattered Joker World to investigate a mysterious slip-shielded structure, fighting through fiend-held installations and ultimately rescuing a trapped divine heart — the Voice of Many — from the demon prince Sigzil's domain.

seasons.title: The Verdant Expanse
seasons.arc_summary: The convox detectives travel to the logging town of Wrenford to investigate husk-murders linked to a mysterious visitor, then venture deep into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse following a feystone compass, rescuing a lost boy and battling a court of fey creatures before learning their prime suspect is already dead.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: Returning to Hallia as the curse claims more victims, the detectives follow fey stone leads to a jeweler's conference and a ritual apartment, where they discover the Gloaming Codex and are pulled into its pages to fight for their lives against carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: Three Sedecium agents investigate an unpowered orbital station half-sunk in the slip, freeing a tortured ship AI and uncovering that the Thessian Gremory (now 'Esoterica') recently accessed the observatory's records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job
seasons.arc_summary: Pulled from retirement, the fire team of Foral, Scrazzy, and Ozzie raids the divine essence of the freshly-killed Thessian god Tithe, navigating Slip puzzles and spider temples to become the first and only team to successfully plant a beacon before the God Eater Harrow devours the remains.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
